general_findings: Large cyan player circle improves localization in airfield and crowded/sparse combat. Quiet and coast views already had relatively high readability; no automatic extra point.
Carrier retains coherent pointed rim and raised island; rounded slab regression from prior packet is absent.

Cyan shoreline band provides tonal transition, but is too uniform and luminous to count as richer natural material rendering; airfield shoreline has a conspicuous change in band near the upper-right coast.
Detailed water, relatively plain land surfaces and simplified models remain mismatched in material complexity.
recommendations: Retain player localization while reducing circle dominance once the player is clearly visible; resolve actual overlap with silhouette treatment.
Replace uniform shoreline glow with irregular shallow-water color, broken foam and varied beach width, eliminating band seams.
Improve wake geometry and material transitions instead of adding more uniform detail.
